acceptance_rules.full_test: frozen Re F3 RMSE must be strictly below formal Re F1 on the same test rows
acceptance_rules.curve_behavior: curve-mean and worst-curve RMSE must both be strictly below formal Re F1
acceptance_rules.target_region: 1300-2000 Hz RMSE must be strictly below formal Re F1
acceptance_rules.guardrails: none of 700-1000, 1300-1650, or 1650-2000 Hz RMSE may worsen more than 10% versus formal Re F1
acceptance_rules.numerical_safety: F1, residual, and final predictions must all be finite
